spots.name: Arc Dome
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 3,590 m (11,779 ft).

spots.name: Miller's Rest Stop
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 237 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L156897.

spots.name: Berlin Mine
spots.tip: A landmark with history. Low light brings out texture; check opening hours if it's fenced.

spots.name: BLM Ground
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint. Check which way it faces: east for sunrise, west for sunset. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.

spots.name: Warm Spring
spots.tip: Steam reads best in cold air at first light. Check access rules; many springs are on private or tribal land.

spots.name: Cedar Sumit
spots.tip: A mountain pass: easy high ground by car. Fog often fills the valleys on either side at sunrise; check winter road conditions.
